outcome: Incidence of post dural puncture headache (PDPH)
cohort: 70 fibromyalgia patients undergoing elective cesarean delivery (Group 1) and 70 women without fibromyalgia undergoing elective cesarean delivery (Group 2)
finding: Fibromyalgia patients undergoing spinal anesthesia for cesarean delivery had a higher incidence and longer duration of PDPH compared to controls.
